evidence.quote: AWS Storage Gateway now supports FIPS 140-3 validated endpoints over AWS PrivateLink for Amazon S3 File Gateway.
Previously, FIPS endpoints for File Gateway were available only over the public internet.
To activate a gateway with a FIPS PrivateLink endpoint, your gateway must be running software version 2.1.10 or later.

evidence.heading: AWS Storage Gateway now supports FIPS-compliant private connectivity for Amazon S3 File Gateway
